Senses.Note: To outshine all before and after praises a saying, exchange, house style, or final act as without predecessor or successor.

ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: To outshine all before and after praises a saying, exchange, house style, or final act as without predecessor or successor.
EvidenceBody: Jiangshan and Fojian apply it to proposed case-turns, Yunju to the Buddha’s exchange, Yuanwu to Caodong house style, and Shiwū to his own funeral pyre.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: Jiangshan and Fojian apply it to proposed case-turns, Yunju to the Buddha’s exchange, Yuanwu to Caodong house style, and Shiwū to his own funeral pyre.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: The phrase is evaluative praise inside particular records, not proof that no historical parallel existed.

ComparedThings: to outshine all before and after
the retained questions, answers, verses, and appraisals
DifferentThingTest.Reason: Reply, exchange, lineage style, and death verse are objects of the same superlative appraisal rather than new lexical referents.

DraftEvidence.AliasRationale: The alias makes the temporal comparison explicit while retaining both the predecessors and successors excluded by the claim.

ModifierControls.Finding: 光 governs both 前 and 絕後 as one balanced unit; phrases containing only 光前 or 絕後 are not substituted.

FamilyControls.Finding: 耀古騰今 is a nearby superlative formula; it corroborates the deployment but is not the same headword.
